name: Grosvenor House
positioning: Grosvenor House, a Luxury Collection Hotel, Dubai: a twin-tower hotel in Dubai Marina, steps from The Walk at JBR, with Marina, sea and Palm Jumeirah views
best_for: Travelers who want a Dubai Marina base near The Walk at JBR
Families or longer stays wanting suites with a kitchen

facts.text: The hotel is in Dubai Marina, within minutes of Dubai Internet City, Media City, golf clubs and malls.
The hotel is steps away from The Walk at JBR, with restaurants and bars overlooking Dubai Marina.
The hotel's twin towers are an instantly recognizable landmark in Dubai Marina.
The hotel complex is set apart by its blue lights and unique architectural designs.
Rooms combine marble floors, natural hues, modern decor and large windows overlooking turquoise waters.
Select rooms have a private balcony.
Rooms and suites come with on-call butler service.
One-bedroom suites have Dubai Marina views, a living room and a fully equipped kitchen.
There is a fully equipped gym in each tower.
Sanara Spa blends holistic therapies with modern practices.
The Level 5 club lounge has a dedicated family lounge for younger guests.
The Luxury Collection Concierge is available 24 hours a day and is a member of Les Clefs d'Or.

highlights.text: Floor-to-ceiling windows frame views of Dubai Marina, the Arabian Sea or Palm Jumeirah.
Guests have access to the private beach at Le Royal Meridien Beach Resort & Spa.
Sanara Spa is a wellness sanctuary inspired by ancient healing and the seven chakras.
The Royal Suites are on the 9th and 10th floors and include a lounge area, kitchenette, dining area and master suite.
City Social by Jason Atherton is on the 43rd floor and serves European cuisine with a focus on wood-fired dishes, with a bar overlooking Palm Jumeirah.

considerations.text: The beach is at Le Royal Meridien Beach Resort & Spa, where guests have access to its private beach, rather than at the hotel itself.
WhataHotel notes the busy marina location can be crowded at peak times.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing reflecting the luxury positioning.
